title: Science spotlight: Is cosmetic tourism a cause for concern?
summary: Cosmetic surgery tourism is booming as patients travel abroad to lower costs, shorten waiting times and access procedures unavailable in certain markets. But according to a review published in Plastic, Reconstructive & Aesthetic Surgery, post-operative complications are a cause for concern. The review analysed 58 studies comprising 1,249 patients who underwent cosmetic procedures abroad and later received treatment for a complication within their local healthcare system. Findings... - Science, R&D

extraction.key_fact_quote: Complications after undergoing cosmetic surgery abroad represent a substantial treatment burden for healthcare systems
